[[Dungeon Lock]]s are a type of lock found in most dungeons. They require a [[Dungeon Key]] to open.

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**[[Arachni's Haunt]] (level 1)
**[[Bloodstone Caves]] (levels 1 and 2)
**[[Bogroot Growths]] (levels 1 and 2)
**[[Catacombs of Kathandrax]] (levels 1 and 2)
**[[Cathedral of Flames]] (levels 1, 2, and 3)
**[[Forsaken Tunnels]] (level 1)
**[[Oola's Lab]] (levels 1 and 2)
**[[Raven's Point]] (level 1)
**[[Rragar's Menagerie]] (levels 2 and 3)
**[[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]]
**[[Shards of Orr]] (levels 1, 2, and 3)
**[[Slavers' Exile]] (Selvetarm's and Forgewight's levels)
